title: AWS Cost Data Tool
content:
The cost monitoring tool is used by DevOps team to keep track of cloud spend by the Kitchen Planner team. The tool runs in the DevOps ipex-agent account.

Full documentation is available in the Git

Background

The tool was originally used to extract the cost of AWS accounts ordered via IKEA IT (Ingka). Nowadays, all accounts used by IPEX are owned by Inter-Ikea organization hence the tool has lost its original purpose, but due to some access to 3Dvia accounts it is still valid.
